svg.title: Four signs agree
svg.desc: Four rows show the four first-order triple passages of one orbital fourfold. Each row has a before, meeting, and after panel at equal scales. A triangle changes sides and contributes a positive passage. The model consists of straight local branches after normal shifts zero, one, three, and seven; it is not a finite-offset orbital simulation.

g.text: One fourfold separates into four positive triples. Follow its first-order lines.
Straight local model · same scale before and after each meeting · no numerical orbital perturbation size asserted
